propositions: Bare-repository fixture commands using implicit cwd-based discovery (git -C <bare> or PWD=<bare>) fail with exit code 128 under safe.bareRepository=explicit policy because Git rejects implicit bare discovery in that mode.
The same fixture commands and repository states succeed under default Git configuration, confirming the failure is environmental policy-dependent rather than repository corruption or venv-related.
Generic helpers encoding only cwd=<bare> routing must be replaced with explicit --git-dir targeting at bare-repository call sites while preserving cwd/-C behavior for worktree operations.

Bare-repository operations span test fixtures (concurrency, prepare-reclaim, reclaim-history) and production code (prepare_reclaim_backup.py restore.git operations), with both mechanisms requiring explicit repository targeting.

Test portability contract requires supported tests to run both locally and in CI without dismissing reproducible local failures; Git 2.55+ enforces safe.bareRepository=explicit as the intended direction.

Repair must preserve all upkeep pins (gc.autoDetach, maintenance.autoDetach, receive.autogc), HEAD ref state (refs/heads/tickets), --no-hardlinks flag, fail-fast checked subprocess behavior, and genuine Git error visibility without introducing retries or masking.
